Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai Assistant Training and Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post at IIT Bhilai is 14 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a two-year PG degree in Management or equivalent from a recognized university, preceded by at least a 3-year Bachelor's Degree in Science/Engineering/Technology with 55% marks or 5.5 CGPA. Two years of relevant experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post is 50 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer (Contractual) position at IIT Bhilai.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the IIT Bhilai Assistant Training and Placement Officer recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual recruitment for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post at IIT Bhilai, with the contract duration specified as three years.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is considered relevant for this role?
faq.answer: Relevant experience includes campus placement in a reputed institute/university, recruitment and placement in a corporate house/MNC, or manpower development and training.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Assistant Training and Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve screening tests, which could include a written test, trade test, or skill test, as indicated in the official notification.
